verdict.rationale: Superpowers is a skills plugin that runs inside third-party harnesses such as Claude Code, Codex CLI, Devin CLI and Gemini CLI. It is invoked via in-harness slash commands and installed through those harnesses' plugin mechanisms, and nothing in the pack shows it ships its own official CLI. A plugin ecosystem could plausibly offer one, so the axis applies, but the evidence does not support it.
